_readme: Locale Qualification Tier registry (data-driven, not tribal knowledge) — the second of the two new registries governing which locales are eligible for the Core Parent Set's default-mirror (see data/core_parent_set.json and CLAUDE.md's 'Locale Parent Governance' section). Read by scripts/lib/locale-parent-registry.js's classifyLocale(code) and decide(). `locales` is keyed by the canonical 30-locale-code list this repo's locale tooling agrees on (mirrors scripts/check-image-assets.py's LOCALES tuple) — every code must appear here so no locale tooling has to guess a default for a code it doesn't recognize. `tier`: 1 = deepen + mirror the Core Parent Set now; 2 = qualify via the existing 7-point language gate, then mirror Core on pass; 3 = hold/stub — no spec mirroring until promoted. `action` is a short human-readable label for the tier. `hold` (only ever true for "vi" today) marks a locale that would otherwise be Tier-2-eligible but is explicitly on hold for a non-content reason recorded in `holdReason` — do not add content there even though the tier number alone would allow it. `notes` is optional free text. Do NOT edit any locale's tier/hold flag unilaterally — every entry here reflects a discussed strategy decision, the same bar CLAUDE.md sets for data/translation_parity_exceptions.json. If a locale's tier looks wrong (or a locale needs promoting after passing the 7-point gate), raise it with the user first rather than editing this file to unblock a page you want to ship.

id.notes: Retains the standing 60% near-term allocation; already the deepest/highest-yield locale (30 /id/ pages carrying by far the highest impression and click volume of any locale).

vi.holdReason: Authority/indexing gap — not a content gap. Do not add vi content; it needs backlinks, not translations.

hi.notes: Named individually as Tier 3 in the strategy doc (9 pages at time of writing). No spec mirroring. Consolidate the switcher, validate head-term demand, then promote via the 7-point gate.

tl.notes: Named individually as Tier 3 in the strategy doc (6 pages at time of writing).

hu.notes: Named individually as Tier 3 in the strategy doc (3 pages at time of writing).

bs.notes: Individually classified 2026-07-26: evidence-confirmed negative — no distinct demand separable from the shared BCS pool (rejected, re-tested 2026-07-24 across ~10 query variants, reconfirmed 2026-07-25; 19 impressions/27 days across the whole tree). No builds, no gate runs absent genuinely new signal. Open subtractive item: the 18-page bs/hr/sr near-duplicate hreflang fix.

cs.notes: Individually classified 2026-07-26: Tier 3 stands on missing data, not a verdict — best-evidenced of the Slavic set (strong fetched forum signal incl. a gaming-nick render-safety wedge; 4+ competitors) but zero keyword volume ever pulled. First in line for a db=cz pull; a gate run without it fails its own point 1.

da.notes: Individually classified 2026-07-26: the old default was stale — 15 pages shipped 2026-07-14, ten days before this bucket was written. Highest ad-market RPM measured (~$8.38); competitor-quantified text-native demand ~12.6k/mo; forum signal thin. Promotion candidate: run the 7-point gate with a first-party GSC pull on the 15 live pages as its first input — a discussed decision, not made here.

hr.notes: Individually classified 2026-07-26: Tier 3 stands. One high-confidence wedge (č/ć/đ/š/ž diacritics-on-foreign-keyboard pain point, corroborated across three independent native threads 2010–2022) but demand not yet shown distinct from the shared BCS pool (50 impressions/27 days), and party to the 18-page BCS near-duplicate liability. Prerequisites for any gate run: the hreflang fix + a db=hr pull.

ms.notes: Added 2026-07-26 — was missing from this registry entirely despite being in the canonical LOCALES tuple with 21 live pages; classifyLocale('ms') was silently hitting the unclassified→Tier-3 fallback, which this entry codifies (no effective behavior change). Shadow locale: not in the runtime switcher, no locales/ms.json. Real located demand (Lemon8/TikTok aesthetic-symbol job; live monetized MY competitors); the gaming/MLBB lane is an evidence-confirmed negative. Promotion gated on: GSC pull for the 21 pages, switcher/JSON reconciliation, and native review of the unvalidated 'huruf power' phrase live on ms/index.html.

no.notes: Individually classified 2026-07-26: the old default was stale — deepest of the former bucket (23 pages incl. a 14-page library build shipped 2026-07-12/13 off a real competitor-mining pass). Quantified market ~8.2k/mo text-native with no Norway-native incumbent; top-tier RPM (~$7.20); strong native forum signal. Promotion candidate, but fix the two known production bugs first (kursiv false-friend page; untranslated English block on no/index.html), then gate run + GSC pull.

ro.notes: Individually classified 2026-07-26: Tier 3 stands, but the 'hold-stub' label was stale — 13 pages shipped 2026-07-15–17. Zero keyword or GSC data on record either way; missing library/symbol pillar. Gate run blocked on a db=ro pull. The 'eliminare diacritice' job found in research is inverse-scope — a discussed scope question, not an automatic build.

sk.notes: Individually classified 2026-07-26: evidence-confirmed — demand is real but non-distinct, served through shared Czech boards (rejected on record, reconfirmed 2026-07-25 via fully-browsed zero-distinct-threads check). Ride the cs engine with light localization; no separate SK program. Closed unless new SK-distinct signal appears.

sr.notes: Individually classified 2026-07-26: evidence-confirmed — the flagship Latin⇄Cyrillic converter concept was dropped 2026-07-25 (all evidence is institutional/cultural register, not personal gaming identity; production is 100% Latin script already), leaving no sr-distinct thesis (63 impressions/27 days, weakest evidence base of the former bucket). Party to the BCS near-duplicate liability. Closed.

sv.notes: Individually classified 2026-07-26: the old default was stale — strongest promotion case of the former bucket. A real 2026-07-12 competitor-mining pull identified substantial untapped symbol/emoji demand; ~half the quantified punch list already shipped (18 pages live). Recommend a formal 7-point gate run — likely Tier 2 — as a discussed decision, not made here. The 'svettiga namn' gaming wedge is real native slang but still unquantified. Update 2026-07-26 (same day): the library/* punch list is now fully shipped, not half — discord-symboler, roblox-symboler, y2k-symboler and emoji-combos were built this session (see data/locale_parent_gap_audit.json's library/*-locale-sv gate-pass entry), matching this entry's own promotion-candidate read.

zh-tw.notes: PROMOTED TO TIER 2 on 2026-08-06 by explicit user decision, on the evidence pack in the lab's ZH-TW-TIER-REVIEW-2026-08-01.md, which recommended exactly this — Tier 2, NOT Tier 1: 'qualify, then mirror Core', so a per-cluster check is still required and blanket mirroring is not authorized. Promotion evidence: highest locale CTR on the site (13.0%); 30 live pages across three high-volume clusters; head-term KD 23-31 at 27K-74K/mo; incumbent tw.piliapp.com shows a template-translation signature (0% native CJK slugs across 2,010 ranking URLs) while UTG's zh-tw graded 5/5 on naturalness; two of the three registry-cited Tier-3 blockers (shadow locale, zh-CN entanglement) were shown not to be real. CAUTIONS CARRIED FORWARD, not resolved by this promotion: the kaomoji cluster failed in this very locale at 110,000/mo, so volume alone has already proven insufficient here; piliapp genuinely dominates the font cluster; and Instrument 3 (TW-segmented GSC on EN parents) was never run. RE-EVALUATION IS SCHEDULED — lab review-register item #27, 2026-10-30, carrying the source review's own PRE-COMMITTED stop condition: if only a minority of the contested-cluster pages clear a meaningful impression floor, drop this locale's default-mirror back to gated. Prior Tier-3 rationale retained for the record: Individually classified 2026-07-26: the old default was doubly stale — 24 live pages (not 12), and the only locale of the former bucket with a proven first-party win (game-name vertical: real clicks and impressions over 3 months, strong CTR on several queries, improving position) alongside two full TW-market competitor-mining passes. The generic kaomoji/homepage bet earned 0 clicks in the same window. Scoped promotion candidate — deepen the game-name vertical, not blanket Core mirroring (CJK script overlay applies); shadow locale (not in the runtime switcher); entangled with the open zh-CN question — resolve together via a discussed gate run.

fi.notes: New locale, launched 2026-07-26 with a starter build (homepage + core category pages + Discord/Instagram font pages + guide trio), matching the hr/hu/da minimal-locale precedent — those three remain Tier 3 in this registry despite being live, larger builds, so fi starts there too rather than skipping ahead. No Semrush access at launch time; real-competitor evidence found via web search instead (fi.piliapp.com — a dedicated Finnish subdomain of an existing multi-locale competitor — plus cooltextmaker.com/fi/, urwatools.com/fi/, and adamfaliq.com/fi/bold-text-generator-suomi/ all independently serving Finnish-language 'fonttigeneraattori'/'tekstigeneraattori' content), recorded in data/locale_parent_gap_audit.json. An internal language-expansion analysis had already flagged Finnish as a Phase-1 candidate alongside ms/da/hu, all three of which are now live.
